I am an experienced international educator who combines human collaboration, developmental and cognitive psychology, quantum principles and creative processes to foster personalized learning.

I teach Italian at the Canadian School of Milan and lead workshops for teachers and students across Europe, from Basel and Turin to Rome and Reykjavík. My work moves between divergent and convergent attention, between talking and building, so that ideas become something people can hold.
